data.name: Formula: RPG
data.detailed_description:
Test the Pre-Alpha!

Play the Demo now!

Thank you to everyone who played and provided feedback during the playtest!

I hope you enjoy the demo, which is the length of one season of racing and about 20-30 minutes of gameplay!

demo hint: urban commuters get far in life

Feel free to reach out via discord or email for any feedback, or just to say hello!


About the Game

Step into a world of motorsport in this Incremental JRPG-inspired Clicker and challenge the competitive world of open-wheel racing.

Develop your team, which includes the mechanic, unlocking more ways to upgrade and tune your set up. 

Upgrade & Tune your car, and challenge the competitive world of open-wheel racing.

Level up and select your route for stat progression, choosing between a calm precision driver, to an urban commuting maniac.

Earn league points to climb the rankings, earning enough money to buy your way to the top leagues.

View leaderboards from other leagues as you make your way to the top.

Enjoy the Nostalgia, with soft references and easter eggs for those with racing knowledge.

Experience the story wrapped in tasteful CRT-4:9 inspired graphics of old.

data.short_description: Experience the story of a struggling team facing bankruptcy in this Incremental JRPG Clicker. Upgrade and tune your car, level up your driver and challenge the competitive world of open-wheel racing. Balance race setup strategies and character progression to find the fastest way around the track.
